The sign reads: "Don't even THINK of parking here" in 
huge letters and "Falmouth Department of Public Works"
in small letters.
column3:
[title29][sentence]
告示牌上用超大字體寫
著「想都別想在這裡停
車」，下面用小字寫著
「法爾茅斯公共工程部
」。

column2:
[title20][sentence]
You contemplate taking the sign, then
remember that you have no good place
to put it.  You decide to leave it here.
column3:
[title20][sentence]
你考慮把告示牌拿走，
但想起自己沒地方放，
於是決定留在原地。

column2:
[title33][sentence]
Wow!  What a cool looking car!  This must
be the mode of transportation they used here.
You recognize this as a magnetically levitated
vehicle, and it looks fairly high-tech, even for
an MLV.
column3:
[title33][sentence]
哇！好酷的一輛車！這
一定是這裡的交通工具
。你認出這是一輛磁浮
車，而且就算是磁浮車
來說，這外型也算相當
高科技了。

column2: [title16][sentence]\nThis is the MLV you were sitting in\na moment ago.
column3: [title16][sentence]\n這就是你剛剛坐的那輛\n磁浮車。

column2: [title26][sentence]\nYou notice a teleporter and an \nelevator on the far wall.
column3: [title26][sentence]\n你注意到對面牆上有個\n傳送器和一部電梯。

column2:
[title30][sentence]
This sidewalk and street continue into a large metropolis.
The size of the city worries you a bit.  It would
be easy to get lost here.  You decide to use
the car and not to stray too far from it.
column3:
[title30][sentence]
這條人行道和街道通往
一座大都市。城市的規
模讓你有點擔心，這裡
很容易迷路。你決定開
車，而且別離車子太遠。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
The building is in reasonably good shape.
Apparently no one paid any attention to the
"post no bills" request.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
這棟建築保存得還算不
錯，看來沒人理會「禁
止張貼」的告示。

column2:
[title29][sentence]
You are at the end of a street which
continues west into a large city.  There
is a formidable metal door in the building
to the north.  A car of some kind is
parked in the street.
column3:
[title29][sentence]
你站在一條街的盡頭，
街道向西通往一座大城
市。北邊的建築物上有
一扇厚重的金屬門，街
上停著一輛不知名的車。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
You notice the security slot next to the
door and conclude that some sort of 
pass card is required.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
你注意到門邊有個安全
插槽，判斷這裡需要某
種通行卡。

column2: [title25][sentence]\nThis looks like a standard fire hydrant.
column3: [title25][sentence]\n這看起來是一般的消防\n栓。

column2: [title25][sentence]\nYou have no urge to get soaking wet.
column3: [title25][sentence]\n你完全沒有把自己弄濕\n的衝動。

column2: [title25][sentence]\nIt looks like plumbing or something.  You\naren't too interested in random pipes.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
看起來像是水管之類的
東西，你對隨便的管線
沒什麼興趣。

column2:
[title22][sentence]
What is this fascination with pipes?
There is nothing, repeat NOTHING interesting
about the pipes.
column3:
[title22][sentence]
你到底是對管線有什麼
迷戀？這些管子沒有，
再說一次，「沒有」任
何有趣的地方。

column2:
[title30]ABANDONED CITY
Wow!  You pause for a moment as you get your
first look at the enormous city.  The entire city
seems to be built inside a gigantic metal cylinder.
You are obviously on the lower of two levels,
and can see that the upper level takes the shape
of a gigantic four-blade fan.  You spend a minute
admiring the architecture.
column3:
[title30]廢棄城市
哇！你停下來看了一眼
眼前這座巨大城市，第
一印象就讓你愣住了。
整座城市似乎建造在一
個超巨大的金屬圓柱體
內。你顯然站在兩層樓
裡的下層，可以看到上
層呈現出巨大四葉風扇
的形狀。你花了一分鐘
欣賞這棟建築。

column2: [title22][sentence]\nIt wouldn't be too much of a swim to go\nover there and get a closer look.
column3: [title22][sentence]\n游過去仔細看看，應該\n不會太遠。

column2: [title20][sentence]\nIt's dead.  However, it does bear a remarkable\nresemblance to the way you look in the morning.
column3:
[title20][sentence]
它死了。不過老實說，
還真有點像你早上起床
的樣子。

column2: [title17][sentence]\nIt looks odd but harmless.
column3: [title17][sentence]\n看起來怪怪的，但沒有\n危害。

column2: [title20][sentence]\nThis is a relatively hard naturally formed mass\nof mineral that . . . O.K., it's a lousy rock.  Big deal.
column3:
[title20][sentence]
這是一塊相對堅硬的天
然礦物集合體……好啦
，就是塊爛石頭，有什
麼大不了。

column2: [title12][sentence]\nIt's green and slimy.
column3: [title12][sentence]\n它又綠又黏。

column2: [title21][sentence]\nThere's more seaweed down there.
column3: [title21][sentence]\n下面還有更多海藻。

column2: [title29][sentence]\nIt's covered with sharp-looking rock formations.\nIt would probably be wise to avoid it.
column3:
[title29][sentence]
上面布滿看起來很銳利
的岩石結構，最好還是
避開比較明智。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
You are in the center of the lagoon.  From here
it appears that you can swim north, south,
or west.
column3:
[title25][sentence]
你在潟湖的正中央。從
這裡看來，你可以往北
、往南，或往西游。

column2: [title29][sentence]\nThe manta swims gracefully along the\nocean floor.
column3: [title29][sentence]\n那隻鬼蝠魟優雅地沿著\n海底游動。

column2: [title29][sentence]\nEven if you could catch it, you have\nno need for it.
column3: [title29][sentence]\n就算你抓得到牠，你也\n用不著。

column2: [title21]TASTY TURKEY\nGosh, that turkey sure does look tasty!  Maybe \nnow would be a good time to eat it...?
column3:
[title21]美味火雞
天哪，這隻火雞看起來
真好吃！現在是不是該
吃掉它了……？

column2:
[title22]OOPS
Oh my!  The turkey just EXPLODED!
It looks like that bedistor board you 
salvaged isn't up to snuff.
column3:
[title22]糟了
天哪！火雞居然「爆炸
」了！看來你回收來的
那塊貝迪斯電路板不太
行。

column2:
[title29]OVEN
You see the ship's oven module.  It is
currently covered with smoking chunks
of flesh left over from that unfortunate
incident with the turkey.
column3:
[title29]烤箱
你看到船上的烤箱模組
，上面還沾著那場火雞
悲劇留下、正冒著煙的
肉塊。

column2:
[width30][center][under]AUXILIARY POWER MODULE
[center][down](a.k.a. "Binky")[cr]
Cute little guy, isn't he?  He may not
look it, but Binky is actually a fully
equipped STELLARTRON XJ-6281Q4 Mark 12 Bionic
Hamsteroid, complete with QR3 fusion-pack whiskers and
a peanut-sized positronic brain.  Believe
it or not, Binky is quite capable of maintaining
life support levels in this craft indefinitely.
column3:
[width30][center][under]輔助電源模組
[center][down]（又稱「賓奇」）[cr]
這小傢伙很可愛吧？雖
然看不太出來，但賓奇
其實是一台配備齊全的
STELLARTRON XJ-6281Q4
Mark 12 型仿生鼠獸，
配有 QR3 融合動力鬍鬚
，還有一顆花生米大小
的正子腦。信不信由你
，賓奇可以無限期維持
這艘船的維生系統運作。

column2:
[title29][sentence]
Don't touch Binky!  Right now, he's the only
thing between you and a "Class One Hyperdrive
Containment Breach".  This generally involves 
the hyperdrive shunt (that big red thing in the middle of the
room) exploding with enough force to split
the planet in half.  Besides, if you touched
Binky with your bare hands the electric charge
would probably blow your hand off.
column3:
[title29][sentence]
別碰賓奇！現在，他是
唯一擋在你和「一級躍
遷圍阻突破事故」之間
的東西。這通常代表房
間中央那個紅色大傢伙
——躍遷分流器，會以
足以把整顆星球劈成兩
半的威力爆炸。而且，
如果你徒手碰賓奇，身
上的電流大概會把你的
手直接炸飛。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
As it happens, Binky is one of the most
loquacious Mark 12 Bionic Hamsteroids you've
ever encountered.  Many are the times the two
of you have sat down for a lengthy discussion
of Aristotle's "Metaphysics" to be followed
by a nice game of hyperchess (sure, the hamster
always wins, but admittedly your cheating has 
come a long way).  Right now, just be thankful that
the auxiliary power module is still "running".
column3:
[title27][sentence]
其實賓奇的話很多，是你
見過最健談的 Mark 12 型
仿生鼠獸。你們倆常坐下
來暢談亞里斯多德的《形
上學》，再下一盤超維西
洋棋（沒錯，倉鼠每次都
贏，不過你的作弊技巧確
實也進步不少）。現在，
你只要慶幸輔助電源模組
還「開著」就好。

column2:
[title30]BIG PIPES
Ordinarily, these pipes deliver super heated steam
from the Hyperdrive Jump Unit to the Dimensional
Rift Engines.  Right now, they seem to be doing a
better job of delivering the aforementioned steam
into the local environment.  Well, you can always
come back here and get your clothes pressed.
column3:
[title30]大水管
平常這些管子負責把超
高溫蒸氣從躍遷裝置輸
送到次元裂隙引擎。不
過現在，它們似乎更擅
長把剛才那些蒸氣直接
排放到周圍環境裡。也
罷，你隨時可以回來這
裡順便燙一下衣服。

column2:
[title32]WARP COIL (RETIRED)
The RQ-11 Kagasaki Warp Coil is ordinarily found at
the base of the Dimensional Rift Engines mount, and
is the primary catalyst for translating the ship
into hyperspace.  This particular unit, however,
now occupies the engineering room floor, and has
obviously seen better days, having recently been
rather abruptly belched through a five-foot bulkhead
by the Quantum Shunt.  It looks like you're going
to have to find another ride off this rock, since
this baby ain't goin' nowhere.
column3:
[title32]曲速線圈（除役）
RQ-11 加賀崎曲速線圈平
常位在次元裂隙引擎座的
底部，是讓飛船躍遷的主
要觸媒。不過這一個現在
卻躺在工程室地板上，顯
然吃了不少苦頭——它最
近才被量子分流器一股腦
轟穿一道五呎厚的艙壁。
看來你得另外找辦法離開
這顆石頭了，這玩意兒是
哪裡都去不了了。

column2: [title22][sentence]\nYou can't take the shovel because the furnace heat \nhas welded the metal to the wall.
column3:
[title22][sentence]
你沒辦法拿走鏟子，因
為熔爐的高溫已經把金
屬焊死在牆上了。

column2: [title22]TAKE COAL!!?!\nAnd get your hands dirty?  NEVER!
column3: [title22]「拿」煤炭！！？\n還把手弄髒？門都沒有！

column2: [title26][sentence]\nIt's hot enough already.  Anyway, you\nknow how sweating makes you stink.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
這裡已經夠熱了。再說
，你也知道流汗會讓你
臭氣沖天。

column2:
[title29][sentence]
Yep, it's a furnace, all right--a StarTech Model 8
Hyperdrive Blast Furnace to be precise.  It is capable
of reaching temperatures similar to, to... well you know -
the hot place where snowballs don't stand a chance.
Right now the door is hanging open, so 
things are nice and toasty around here.
column3:
[title29][sentence]
沒錯，這確實是座熔爐
——精確地說，是
StarTech Model 8 型躍
遷高爐。它能達到的溫
度，大概就跟……你知
道的——那個雪球完全
撐不住的地方差不多熱。
現在爐門正開著，所以
這裡才會這麼溫暖舒適。

column2:
[title25][sentence]
Lean over and put your head next to the
fire so that your brain can warm up.  It's 
already open, Einstein!
column3:
[title25][sentence]
把頭湊到火邊，讓腦子
暖和一下吧。它「已經
開著了」，愛因斯坦！

column2: [title20][sentence]\nThe hinges appear to be broken.
column3: [title20][sentence]\n鉸鏈看起來壞掉了。

column2:
[title33]PLEKHANOV SHIELD GENERATOR
If it weren't for this baby right here, you
would probably be a rapidly expanding cloud
of subatomic particles.  The Plekhanov Shield
Generator is, in layman's terms, responsible for
keeping the ship from being blasted into tiny chunks
by such malevolent energies as might happen to cross
its path.  Apart from your (cough) legendary piloting
skills, the P.S.G. is the main reason you survived your
recent encounter.  Now get your mind off of Miss Cuspidor 
and start thinking about getting past that big warship
(assuming you ever make orbit again, that is).
column3:
[title33]普列漢諾夫護盾產生器
若不是這個小傢伙，你現在大概
已經是一團快速擴散的亞原子粒
子雲了。用白話講，普列漢諾夫
護盾產生器負責保護飛船，不被
路過的惡意能量炸成碎片。除了
你那（咳）傳說級的駕駛技術之
外，P.S.G. 是你在最近那場遭
遇戰裡活下來的主要原因。現在
別再想卡斯匹多小姐了，開始想
想要怎麼繞過那艘大型戰艦吧（
前提是你還能再入軌一次）。

column2:
[title33]HYPERDRIVE JUMP UNIT
This is the infamous RICHARDS 421-K 
Turbocharged Ten Cell Hyperdrive
Accelerating Jump Unit, with a special 
child-resistant anti-matter access module.  
You bought this one from the universal 
cable shopping channel (Channel TT412).
column3:
[title33]躍遷裝置
這就是惡名昭彰的
RICHARDS 421-K 型十
電池渦輪增壓躍遷加速
裝置，還配有兒童安全
鎖反物質存取模組。你
是在全宇宙電視購物頻
道（TT412 頻道）買下
這台的。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
The gauge indicates the pressure in
the large overhead pipes.  As you can
see, the flow is now somewhat erratic,
which just might have something to do
with being shot down and crashing into
the ocean floor.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
這個壓力錶顯示著頭頂
大水管裡的壓力。你可
以看到，現在的流量有
點不太穩定，這大概跟
被擊落、一路墜進海底
不無關係。

column2:
[title30][sentence]
This is the manual override for the Hyperdrive
and the main power system.  Normally you could
alter the power grid from here, or control engine 
output levels.  The console evidently sustained 
some damage during the crash-landing
because it is now completely dead.
column3:
[title30][sentence]
這是躍遷裝置和主電力
系統的手動超馳控制。
平常你可以在這裡調整
電網，或控制引擎輸出
等級。這個控制台顯然
在迫降時受損了，現在
完全沒反應。

column2:
[title24][sentence]
This is an emergency rebreather which
seems to have fallen off of its safety
mount.  It allows the wearer to breathe
in a inhospitable environment such as 
underwater or in a men's locker room.
column3:
[title24][sentence]
這是一具緊急水中呼吸
器，似乎是從固定架上
掉下來的。它能讓配戴
者在惡劣環境中呼吸，
例如水底，或是……男
生更衣室。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
On the workbench is a timing device that you
recently repaired.  Although it was designed to 
fire retro-burners at fixed intervals, you found a better
use for it--to let you know when the turkey was done.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
工作台上有一個你最近
修好的計時裝置。雖然
它原本設計是要定時點
燃反推噴嘴，但你發現
它更好的用途——提醒
你火雞什麼時候烤好。

column2:
[title20][sentence]
Through all the grease and grime you can
just barely make out the pattern of your
asphalt tiling.
column3:
[title20][sentence]
透過滿滿的油污和髒垢
，你勉強能看出瀝青地
磚的花紋。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
After assessing the damage you wish you had 
brought your tool box.  Inside the tool box is a 
bottle of whiskey and, right now, you could really
use a stiff drink.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
評估完損害狀況後，你
真希望自己有帶工具箱
。工具箱裡有一瓶威士
忌，而現在的你，真的
很需要來一杯烈酒。

column2:
[title30]OVEN
This is the first time you have tested the oven since
you installed that salvaged bedistor board.  The
turkey looks just about done.
column3:
[title30]烤箱
自從裝上那塊回收來的
貝迪斯電路板後，這是
你第一次測試這個烤箱
。火雞看起來快烤好了。

column2:
[title27]WORKBENCH
The recent beating your ship took has thrown almost
everything off your little workbench.  There is a small
timing device here.
column3:
[title27]工作台
你的船最近挨了一頓「
毒打」，把工作台上的
東西幾乎全震飛了。這
裡有個小型計時裝置。

column2: [title27]WORKBENCH\nThe recent beating your ship took has thrown almost\neverything off your little workbench.
column3:
[title27]工作台
你的船最近挨了一頓「
毒打」，把工作台上的
東西幾乎全震飛了。

column2:
[title33][sentence]
Your little maneuver with the time bomb
has moistened the city a tad.  Only a single
building protrudes above the water
in the distance.  The boat you lowered is floating
just out of reach.
column3:
[title33][sentence]
你那手定時炸彈的小把
戲，把這座城市「弄濕
」了一點。遠處只剩一
棟建築露出水面。你放
下水的小船就漂在不遠
不近的地方，搆不太到。

column2:
[title33][sentence]
Your little maneuver with the time bomb
has moistened the city a tad.  Only a single
building protrudes above the water in the
distance.
column3:
[title33][sentence]
你那手定時炸彈的小把
戲，把這座城市「弄濕
」了一點。遠處只剩一
棟建築露出水面。

column2:
[title26][sentence]
The city lies completely under the
surface of the water.  You can see
nothing except a single
tower in the distance.
column3:
[title26][sentence]
整座城市完全沉在水面
之下，你只能看到遠處
一座孤零零的高塔。

column2:
[title20][sentence]
You may not want to use this any more.
It would be safe to assume that going
down would be a wet experience.
column3:
[title20][sentence]
你大概不會想再用這個
了。可以確定的是，往
下走一定會弄得一身濕。

column2:
[title30][sentence]
The rim of the city is obviously the top
of the volcano cone.  The short section
you are standing on has been paved, and
you imagine that it may have been a maintenance
platform.
column3:
[title30][sentence]
城市的邊緣顯然就是火
山口的頂端。你站著的
這一小段路面經過鋪設
，你猜這裡可能曾經是
個維修平台。

column2:
[title27][sentence]
These probably served some purpose
during the construction of the city.  Time and
weather have taken their toll on these
outcroppings, in some cases revealing
the reinforcing steel beneath.  A sharp hook
protrudes from the upper corner of the
right-most pylon.
column3:
[title27][sentence]
這些東西在城市建造時
大概發揮過某種作用。
歲月和風化在這些突起
物上留下痕跡，有些地
方甚至露出裡面的鋼筋
。最右邊那根橋墩的上
角，伸出一個銳利的鉤
子。

column2:
[title20][sentence]
A sharp piece of metal pokes out from one
of the cement pylons.  Weather has rusted
most of the metal away.
column3:
[title20][sentence]
一塊尖銳的金屬從其中
一根水泥橋墩伸出來，
風化已經把大部分金屬
鏽蝕殆盡。

column2: [title17][sentence]\nThe fishing line you tied to the hook\nis still here.
column3: [title17][sentence]\n你綁在鉤子上的釣魚線\n還在這裡。

column2:
[title21][sentence]
The rim of the city is surrounded
by igneous rock.  It is blue-purple
in color and is porous.
column3: [title21][sentence]\n城市邊緣被火成岩包圍\n，顏色藍紫，質地多孔。

column2: [title16][sentence]\nYou don't need any pumice.
column3: [title16][sentence]\n你不需要任何浮石。

column2: [title24][sentence]\nTo the east you see a teleporter\nbooth.
column3: [title24][sentence]\n你在東邊看到一座傳送\n亭。

column2: [title22][sentence]\nIn the distance you see the only building\nthat rises above the water.
column3: [title22][sentence]\n遠處，你看到唯一一棟\n露出水面的建築。

Not bad!  The boat managed to
stay upright during the flooding,
and is now floating just out of reach.
